osullivan_ma.text: Dia dhuit! That means 'God to you', and you answer 'Dia is Muire dhuit'. Then you may sit and have tea.
Selkie stories say seals take off their skins to walk ashore as people. A Selklet pup is born white, and the pale fur goes in weeks.
Our Cian has Irish homework. 'Go raibh maith agat' is thank you. He can say it fine. He cannot say it to his sister.
